scripts.setup: npm --prefix packages/domain ci && npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/domain test && npm --prefix apps/api test && node --test apps/web/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.stop:local: docker compose --project-name campus-judge-local --env-file deploy/.env.local -f deploy/compose.local.yaml stop
